title: A Fused Gaussian Process Bandit Framework for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.32092v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used to maximize expensive black-box functions when direct evaluation is costly. In many real-world applications, the high-fidelity objective can be approximated by a series of lower-fidelity models that provide partial but informative signals at substantially reduced cost. Multi-fidelity BO (MFBO) algorithms aim to strategically combine these information sources to achieve an optimal trade-off between accuracy and evaluation cost. However, existing MFBO methods often oversimplify the complex dependencies between fidelity levels or rely on heuristic acquisition functions that lack theoretical performance guarantees. translated_title: 面向多保真度贝叶斯优化的融合高斯过程老虎机框架
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）被广泛应用于直接评估成本高昂时对昂贵黑盒函数进行最大化。在许多实际应用中，高保真度目标可以通过一系列低保真度模型来近似，这些模型以大幅降低的成本提供部分但具有参考价值的信息信号。多保真度贝叶斯优化（MFBO）算法旨在战略性地组合这些信息源，以在精度与评估成本之间实现最优权衡。然而，现有的MFBO方法往往过度简化了保真度层级之间复杂的依赖关系，或依赖于缺乏理论性能保证的启发式采集函数。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种将MFBO问题表述为融合高斯过程老虎机问题的新框架，并开发了相应的融合高斯过程置信上界（FGP-UCB）算法。我们的方法通过融合多保真度信息来准确预测高保真度函数。
tldr: 该论文将多保真度贝叶斯优化问题创新性地表述为融合高斯过程老虎机问题，并开发了具有理论性能保证的FGP-UCB算法，从而更准确地建模保真度层级间的复杂依赖关系。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel formulation of multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization as a fused Gaussian Process bandit problem and develops the FGP-UCB algorithm with theoretical performance guarantees, enabling more accurate modeling of complex dependencies across fidelity levels.
